description:
Professional-Grade 5500W Electric Off-Road Motorcycle Motor - 70 Nm Torque: This high-performance electric off-road motorcycle for teens and adults features a 5500W motor paired with a waterproof controller. Its all-terrain wide tires incorporate progressive lug spacing, cold-resistant soft compound material, and cut-resistant construction, making it the ideal choice for off-road adventures, mountain climbing, and trail riding.
Top speed of 28+MPH: Easily conquers 45° steep slopes and rock climbs, making it the ideal choice for mountain off-road adventures. It allows you to easily adapt to various terrains and riding styles, bringing you a truly all-terrain adventure experience.
Extra-large capacity battery & ultra-long range: The battery capacity is 60V 30Ah, and the GT16P waterproof electric bicycle battery has BMS function, providing overcharge/over-discharge protection to reduce battery degradation. Suitable for electric motorcycles for ages 13 and up, with a range of 80 miles per charge (depending on specific conditions such as speed, temperature, terrain, etc.).

components.description: Higher-voltage battery and compact off-road riding
